headline: Growth & Business Development Professional | B2B Sales & Outreach Specialist
summary: Results-oriented Growth and Business Development professional with a Bachelor of Business Administration and extensive experience in cross-market client acquisition and stakeholder engagement. Proven track record in identifying high-value opportunities, executing personalized multi-channel outreach, and building qualified pipelines across MENA, EU, and Asian markets. Skilled in translating business research into compelling narratives and driving measurable growth through persistence, strategic account mapping, and strong relationship management. Eager to leverage strong communication skills and B2B prospecting expertise to generate enterprise pipeline for Rockbot.

experience.title: Growth & Business Development Manager
bullets: Identified and engaged high-value prospects and key stakeholders across MENA, EU, and Asian markets, building a robust pipeline of qualified business opportunities.
Executed personalized, multi-channel outreach strategies (email, social, direct communication) to connect with decision-makers and drive conversion rates.
Conducted deep-dive account research to understand organizational structures, priorities, and leadership, tailoring outreach messages to specific business pain points.
Managed full-funnel KPIs including lead generation, conversion optimization, and sales funnel progression, ensuring accurate tracking of activities and opportunities.
Collaborated with senior leadership to prioritize target accounts and refine outreach strategies based on engagement data and market feedback.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Built and managed relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and influencers, acting as a bridge between the brand and high-value community members.
Drove user growth and engagement through targeted campaign management and persistent, consistent interaction with target audiences.
Developed compelling content and outreach materials that resonated with diverse international audiences, enhancing brand visibility and trust.
Analyzed engagement metrics to refine communication strategies, ensuring maximum impact from every touchpoint.

experience.title: Freelance Client Relations & Project Lead
bullets: Managed end-to-end client lifecycle for 150+ projects, from initial discovery and scoping to delivery and post-sale support.
Negotiated contracts and proposals with clients across 12+ countries, ensuring alignment on scope, budget, and deliverables.
Maintained 100% client satisfaction through proactive communication, transparent reporting, and rapid response to inquiries.
Utilized CRM and project management tools to track client interactions, deadlines, and project status with precision.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Enterprise SDR role at Rockbot. With a background in Growth Marketing and Business Development, I have spent years identifying high-value prospects and building relationships with key stakeholders across global markets. I thrive on the research-heavy, personalized outreach required to open doors for enterprise brands. My experience in translating business insights into compelling outreach, combined with my persistence and structured approach to pipeline management, aligns perfectly with Rockbot's mission to elevate real-world experiences. I am eager to bring my energy and strategic prospecting skills to your Enterprise Sales team.

screening.q: Do you have 2-5 years of sales development, business development, or outbound sales experience?
Do you have experience with Salesforce or similar CRM tools?
Do you have experience with sales prospecting tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or Outreach?
screening.a: No - but strong LinkedIn/email prospecting and CRM (HubSpot/Pipedrive) experience

screening.q: Do you have a Bachelor's degree?
Do you have experience selling into multi-location businesses or enterprise organizations?
screening.a: No direct enterprise-org sales; transferable B2B outreach/BD experience
